About Us

Leyew Furniture is a furniture workshop. We design, build and install kitchens, beds, sofas, dining sets, wardrobes and wooden doors, made to the size and style you choose.

How It Works

  1. Tell us what you need, with size and style.
  2. We send a price and timeline.
  3. We build it and install it for you.
